reuse.why: All month-wide actions, including the new last-month-spending one, take their categories from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and their sign from averageToBudget, but the #fixed check is a hand-written regex instead of the shared extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: No copied blocks: every exclusion rule is added once inside the shared selection; the only overlap is the regex reimplementing tag parsing.

placement.why: The exclusions live in the bulk-category selection in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the selection helper, the month-wide actions' signatures, the new action and its tests.

maintainability.why: One selection function holds every rule, though the inline goal_def JSON parsing, the ad-hoc tag regex and reusing averageToBudget (named for averages) for last-month spending make it slightly harder to read.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories in server/budget/actions.ts matches `#fixed` with its own regex instead of shared/tags extractTagsFromText

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories' includeHidden parameter is replaced (not added to) by includeHiddenCategories; the new rules are general exclusions inside it and every month-wide action, including setLastMonthSpending, calls it
